- **Gate-2 inline correction did not trigger a downstream user-facing-doc sweep.** When the implementer re-spawn shipped per-AR emission, three user-facing docs (architecture/authority-chain.md, operations/authority-chain-operations.md, m1/architecture/audit-events.md) had been authored before the correction with "deferred per FOLLOWUP-02" wording. Cost paid: orchestrator-applied trivial-multi 3-doc patch + 1 audit B re-iter (~20 min total). **Process-level miss: no gate-2-correction-aware doc-sync sweep.** § 5 row 3 closes.
- **`cargo:test` 4-stage pipeline at gate-4 is a granular-bash-discipline violation.** The orchestrator (and possibly the implementer) authored a `cargo test ... 2>&1 | grep ... | sed ... | awk ...` 4-stage pipeline 9 times to extract `passed/failed/ignored` counts. - **Migration number assumption error in the plan.** Plan §"Forks for orchestrator" line 97 said "migration 0011" was next-free; actual next-free was **0014** (3 slots already used by CH-23/CH-10/CH-11). Implementer corrected at P0 (filed under 0014_authority_chain.surql). No code-level impact, but the plan was slightly ahead of reality. § 5 row 5 closes.
- **`PrincipalRef` lacks `PartialEq` derive.** Implementer found at gate-2 P3 work that `PrincipalRef` cannot be `==`-compared, so `is_bootstrap_ar` falls back to `matches!(ar.requestor, PrincipalRef::System(s) if s == SYSTEM_GENESIS_PRINCIPAL)` (axioms.rs:68-75). Works correctly but is more verbose than typed equality. **Surface-level miss; not blocking; minor follow-up.** § 5 row 7 captures.
- **Permissions: bash-check 4-cycle pattern.** CH-13 (4) → CH-07 (3) → CH-08 (15) → CH-14 (43). CH-08 retro Row 7 mandated `matcher-semantics-investigation` escalation with empirical test-harness validation. CH-08 user broadened the rule pattern to `Bash(bash /root/projects/phi/baby-phi/scripts/*.sh *)` + `Bash(bash /root/projects/phi/baby-phi/scripts/*.sh 2>&1*)` at 07:36 UTC 2026-05-08 (mid-CH-08-retro-prep). **Empirically these patterns still don't match.** 43 prompts in CH-14 vs target 0. § 5 row 6 escalates per CH-08 retro Row 7's protocol.
